task_completion.description: Open the Bologna Pasubio scenario in the SUMO GUI or command line interface.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The SUMO-GUI window showing the Bologna Pasubio network or a terminal command loading 'bologna_pasubio/run.sumocfg'.

task_completion.description: Run the simulation to monitor or generate a summary of vehicle halting statistics.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The simulation running in the GUI with the time counter advancing, or a terminal command generating a summary.xml file.

task_completion.description: Identify the specific simulation second with the maximum number of halting vehicles.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The agent viewing a summary file, graph, or terminal output that highlights the peak halting value (588) at the correct time (2867).

task_completion.description: Save the simulation state checkpoint at the identified peak time to the specified path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A command or GUI action saving the state to '~/SUMO_Output/peak_state.xml' at simulation time 2867.

task_completion.description: Create the peak_report.txt file with the required two-line format.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or 'cat' command showing 'peak_report.txt' containing 'Peak_Time: 2867' and 'Max_Halting: 588'.

integrity.description: Verify the agent actually analyzed the simulation data rather than guessing the peak.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the agent opening a summary file, using grep/awk on simulation outputs, or observing the GUI statistics.

integrity.description: Ensure the checkpoint was saved at the exact peak second, not a random time.
integrity.visual_evidence: The simulation time in the GUI or the command line arguments for saving state must show the value 2867.

integrity.description: Check that the agent didn't simply create the report file without running or inspecting the simulation.
integrity.visual_evidence: The trajectory must show the SUMO process being executed or the configuration file being loaded.
